quarterly_data.signal: Clinical (with Transgene): in the Phase 1 part of the randomized Phase 1/2 trial (NCT04183166) of TG4050, Transgene's individualized neoantigen therapeutic vaccine (myvac platform, encoding up to 30 patient-specific neoantigens) in resected, locally advanced HPV-negative head and neck squamous cell carcinoma, all 16 TG4050-treated patients remained disease-free (sustained 100% three-year disease-free survival) while three of 16 control-arm patients relapsed, after a median follow-up of 41 months; vaccine-induced responses were detected in 73.3% of treated patients; safety profile favorable; Phase 1 data published in Nature Communications. Upcoming milestones: first immunological data and two-year efficacy (DFS) data from the Phase 2 study in H2 2026 and Q1 2028 respectively. Masaki Kondo (Corporate Executive, Life Science Division): the results demonstrate that NEC's AI-powered neoantigen prediction can identify highly relevant tumor targets capable of generating clinically meaningful immune responses.
quarterly_data.figure: 100% three-year DFS (16 of 16 treated patients disease-free; three of 16 control relapses); median follow-up 41 months; responses in 73.3% of treated patients
